description: Deterministic hand-computable golden test cases for Phase 6D Full-Day Meal Planning.

cases.description: Full day where all scheduled meals are feasible and aggregate daily totals fall squarely within Phase 5A neutral targets. J_day = 0.0.
All meals individually satisfy their assigned meal targets (J*=0 for each), but the combined aggregate energy exceeds daily target bounds. Demonstrates independence of meal vs day feasibility.
One scheduled meal fails (e.g., conflicting required entity or no valid combination). With require_all_meals=True, returns PARTIAL_DAY_GENERATED, exact failed role, and no false complete plan.
Two candidate day configurations with identical daily primary objective J_day. Day plan with higher user preference match coverage ranks higher.
Identical daily schedule, constraints, and preferences executed under GENERAL, PCOS, and MALE_HYPOGONADISM. Must produce 100% identical compositions, grams, and daily totals.
One or more foods in the day has unknown fiber. Day aggregation must report fiber_coverage_status=PARTIAL, record missing_fiber_entity_ids, and never convert missing fiber to zero.
